name: Sika Wonder Wipes
paste:
SIKA® WONDER WIPES: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Wonder Wipes, April 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sika-wonder-wipes.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Wonder Wipes where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Wonder Wipes are specially formulated to clean hands, tools and surfaces from wet and semi-cured paint, sealant, adhesive, bitumen, expanding foam, oil, grease and even silicone. Particularly useful when there is no water on site.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Cleaning wet and semi-cured paints, sealants, adhesives, bitumen, polyurethanes, expanding foams, polyester fillers and epoxies from hands, tools and surfaces.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Wonder Wipes
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: MULTI-USE CLEANING WIPES FOR THE BUILDING TRADE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Sika® Wonder Wipes and Sika® Wonder Wipes Biodegradable contain an anti-bacterial additive tested by an independent laboratory to EN 1276 chemical disinfectants and antiseptics.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 1276: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Cleans hands, tools and surfaces.
    - Formulated to remove the toughest of grime.
    - Contains an anti-bacterial additive.
    - Contains aloe vera to condition skin and prevent dryness and cracking.
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Tub containing 100 wipes
    - Shelf life: Sika® Wonder Wipes must be used within 36 months from the date of manufacture and within 6 months from opening.
    - Storage conditions: Store in cool dry conditions away from direct sunlight between +5 °C and +25 °C. Storage outside these parameters will significantly reduce shelf life.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Tub
    - Pull off lid and open closure. Find start wipe in centre of roll. Pull out approx 30 cm of wipes and thread through lid. Replace lid immediately and reseal closure.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not use on porous surfaces such as untreated wood.
    - Do not dispose of wipes in toilets.
    - Use only as directed.
    - Store only in original container.
    - As with all detergents / products containing detergents, people with sensitive or damaged skin should avoid prolonged contact with skin.
    - It is the users responsibility to determine suitability for use. If in doubt, contact our Technical Services department for advice.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Wonder Wipes, April 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sika-wonder-wipes.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of products, users should refer to the most recent Voluntary Safety Information.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
